meta.title: Significant affordable-housing development activity in Colorado
meta.scope: Every project a state agency recorded from 2016 on: CHFA tax-credit applications and awards, OEDIT Prop 123 awards (administered by CHFA), DOLA Division of Housing awards, and CHFA's tax-credit property list. Market-rate projects are not here; no public source lists them project by project.

stages.under_construction: CHFA's property list shows it in its construction phase
stages.funded: A state agency awarded it credits, a grant or a loan
stages.land_funded: Prop 123 Land Banking paid for the land; no homes are funded yet
stages.applied: An application is in, and its round has not been decided
stages.not_funded: Applied, and the round's award report does not list it
stages.letter_of_intent: A letter of intent is on CHFA's rolling list

meta.stage_rule: A project's stage is the furthest stage any source records for it. A loss followed by a later application reads as applied. Nothing here says a project is built or open: CHFA's property feed copies the allocation year into its placed-in-service field for recent deals, so that field is not used.
meta.join_rule: Events are one project when their names match after normalising (the rule scripts/funding/build_lihtc_applications.py uses to match applications to awards) and their counties agree. A project renamed between application and award stays two rows.
meta.amount_note: Amounts are as printed: tax credits are ANNUAL credit amounts; grants and loans are dollars. amount_label says which. Never add credits to dollars.
meta.public_safety: Sponsor, owner and contact fields are not copied, and quotes have them removed. Projects on the owner exclusion list are left out by hash.
meta.program_awards_note: Awards that fund a program rather than homes on a site (down payment assistance, rehabilitation programs, statewide NOFAs, Prop 123 Modular Finance loans to factories) are counted here and not listed.
meta.summary_note: county_summary counts projects whose latest event is 2023 or later (the latest year any source records, 2026, less three), by stage, with homes as printed (total units). Counties with none are listed with zeros.
